metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Dept. Q
metas.description: Carl, a former top-rated detective, is wracked with guilt following an attack that left his partner paralyzed and another policeman dead. On his return to work, Carl is assigned to a cold case that will consume his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2024 · Black Doves
metas.description: After her lover is murdered by members of London's underworld, a spy - who is publicly the wife of the British Defence Secretary - is protected by an old friend from their agency.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Bodies
metas.description: Four detectives, living in different eras -1890, 1941, 2023 and 2053 - find the body of the same murder victim in Whitechapel. They soon come to realize their investigations have them central to a conspiracy spanning over 150 years.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · Anatomy of a Scandal
metas.description: A sexual consent scandal amongst British privileged elite and the women caught up in its wake.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · The Devil's Hour
metas.description: A woman wakes up every night at exactly 3.33AM, in the middle of the so-called devil's hour between 3AM and 4AM.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Karen Pirie
metas.description: When a historic murder case in St Andrews becomes the subject of a true crime podcast, fearless DS Karen Pirie is tasked with solving it.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Sherwood
metas.description: Two shocking and unexpected murders shatter an already fractured community leading to one of the largest manhunts in British history.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Red Eye
metas.description: A London detective's investigations lead her into the world of national security.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Magpie Murders
metas.description: Editor Susan Ryeland gets drawn into a web of intrigue and murder when she receives Alan Conway's unfinished manuscript of an Atticus Pünd mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · Why Didn't They Ask Evans?
metas.description: A dying man's enigmatic last words send vicar's son, Bobby Jones, and his socialite friend, Lady Frankie Derwent, on a crime-solving adventure.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Patience
metas.description: Patience catalogues evidence in the Yorkshire Police records department. A brilliant self-taught criminologist with keen crime scene instincts, her talent is spotted by Metcalf, opening new worlds for the archivist.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · The Chelsea Detective
metas.description: Detective Inspector Max Arnold, whose lifestyle on a battered houseboat in Chelsea's Cheyne Walk contrasts sharply with the affluent elite whose crimes he helps solve alongside partner DS Layla Walsh.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Beyond Paradise
metas.description: Having left Saint Marie to be with Martha, DI Humphrey Goodman starts a new life with her in Devon, bringing his unique brand of chaotic genius to the small, close-knit community.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · Harry Wild
metas.description: A recently retired English professor discovers a real knack for investigation and cannot help but interfere with the cases assigned to her police detective son.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2024 · The Marlow Murder Club
metas.description: Judith, Suzie and Becks start an investigation. To assist with official police investigation, headed by Tanika, They must suspect witnesses, and face down real danger as they work against the clock to stop the killer in their tracks.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · DI Ray
metas.description: Newly promoted DI Rachita Ray takes on a case that forces her to face a lifelong personal conflict.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2024 · Ellis
metas.description: DCI Ellis and DS Harper arrive at police stations to solve murder cases. Despite being overlooked, Ellis is a determined detective driven by a quest for justice and compassion.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · Murder in Provence
metas.description: Antoine Verlaque, Investigating Judge in Aix-en-Provence with his romantic partner Marine Bonnet, investigates the murders, mysteries and dark underbelly of their idyllic home in the south of France.
